name: Kaisaki Ryouichi
source:
He lives with his sister Nana after their parents died in an accident. One day his sister Nana got insulted by a group of rich men. 
He becomes a lecturer at a girls school where children of the rich men study. He invites the rich men's daughters to a remote villa for supplementary classes to have his desired revenge.
